steps.note: Open the multi-stage create screen with its default Auction stage.
Open the Add Stages menu for the first move.
Open the Auction stage overflow menu for deletion.
Confirm deletion of the Auction stage if the confirmation control is shown.
Verify the first delete leaves only the Technical Stage.
Open Add Stages for the third move.
Open the Technical Stage overflow menu for deletion.
Confirm deletion of the Technical Stage if the confirmation control is shown.
Verify exactly one RFQ stage remains after the second delete.
Explicitly select the RFQ tab so its panel renders.
Assert exactly one tab remains and it is RFQ.
Verify the RFQ-specific create panel is rendered with its template control.
